summary: Iteration 5 (gallery configurator + per-cell aspect). Backend: 9/9 new tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_cell_aspect.py (parametrised over fill/1:1/4:3/3:2/3:4/2:3 for jpg/png/pdf; mixed-aspect PNG dims match round(cm/2.54*dpi); 1:1 cell in 20x10cm canvas leaves magenta bg margins at left/right while center pixel is photo; 'fill' cell shows no bg margins). Regression: crop_marks+ICC FOGRA39 suite still 7/7 green; gallery_layout 4/5 pass initially (fixed pre-existing bug: 'paper':'A4' string was rejected by pydantic FormatSpec, replaced with {'w_cm':21.0,'h_cm':29.7}). Frontend Playwright end-to-end: Formato tab shows riquadri-count-slider + riquadri-count-input (1..50); setting count=9 updates footer to '9 riquadri'; layout-mode-grid shows 3 variants (variant-0..2), layout-mode-mixed shows 2 variants; clicking layout-variant-1 changes arrangement without console errors; Cornice tab label 'Spessore bordo tra i riquadri' present; auto-arrange-button assigns photos (worked for the current cells); selecting cell-item-0 + Cella tab reveals 'Forma della foto' group with all six testids (cell-aspect-fill/1x1/4x3/3x2/3x4/2x3); cell-aspect-1x1 -> photo becomes square with visible white margins in preview; cell-aspect-fill restores cover; export-menu-button -> export-high-res-jpg-button downloads 'Nuovo_collage.jpg' successfully; 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py render_cell: aspect parsing uses float split on ':' with no try/except - a malformed aspect like '1:0' would ZeroDivisionError. Since Pydantic doesn't constrain the string, consider validating aspect against {'fill','1:1','4:3','3:2','3:4','2:3'} on the CellSpec model (e.g., Literal or field_validator) to fail fast with 422 rather than 500.

render_cell now uses bg_rgb sourced from spec.background_color for BOTH the inner box padding and the outer cell padding. This is correct for 1:1 preview parity, but means users cannot set a distinct 'letterbox' color per cell (acceptable per current spec).
Pre-existing tests/test_gallery_layout.py::test_export_pdf_professional_with_many_cells used 'paper':'A4' string - fixed to FormatSpec dict.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Per-cell aspect validated backend+frontend. Aspect testids on frontend use 'x' instead of ':' (cell-aspect-1x1 etc). Grid mode currently exposes 3 variants for n=9 and mixed exposes 2; if variant count contract changes, update Playwright expectations. Consider adding a Pydantic validator for CellSpec.aspect to prevent 500s on malformed input.
